title: 第1章 魔物森林第2章 争斗
slug: 从哥布林开始骑马砍杀
content_zh:
（ps：我想在这本书探讨一下生活习生理信仰都不一样的种族如何组建成现代化国家。
另外如何用法律约束各种传奇生物，比如永生者杀人了，怎么处罚他，蠕虫人杀人了，分裂成几千条蠕虫，和别的蠕虫人重组，变成新的人，怎么认定犯罪人员。
pps：鉴于这本书暂时唯一一个差评居然是因为本书有女角色，我打算用一句话让各位了解这本书的基调：
充满美好爱恋的大脑，也会被黑火药推进的弹丸炸成四处飞溅的组织。）
魔物森林。
某个如同垃圾站的哥布林部落，几百个长相丑陋，身高只有常人一半的哥布林围成一圈，他们面露贪婪，看着圈中一只刚捕到的野猪，咕噜咕噜咽着口水。
饥饿让他们想立马扑上去撕咬，可野猪边进食的高大身影却让他们不敢寸进，那个高大身影是这支哥布林部落的首领。
首领哥布林身高接近普通人，对于一米不到的哥布林来说，他已经是庞然大物，而且他不但长的高，还异常肥胖，肚子圆滚滚，里面充满肥油，绝对是位三高患者。
“嗝！”
哥布林首领趴在野猪边疯狂撕咬，等野猪只剩半只后，他打了个饱嗝，一摇一晃朝哥布林部落唯一的建筑茅草屋走去。
他直接躺下，呼噜声立马响起，这声音就像是食堂的哨声，没了首领的压制，哥布林们再也忍耐不住，冲上去疯狂撕咬半拉野猪。
不一会儿，半拉野猪也没了，就剩个骷髅架子在原地，吃饱喝足的哥布林们散开，随便找了块地方躺下就睡，一副吃一顿算一顿的良好心态。
等众哥布林都睡着，哥布林幼崽们从各种角落里爬出来，贪婪舔舐着和泥巴混在一起的猪血。
“不行啊，我tm得另谋出路！”
一只哥布林幼崽看着同胞兄弟趴在地上啃咬泥沙的凄惨样，心中如此想着。
这只哥布林叫李秦武，蓝星人，一个星期前熬夜玩骑马与砍杀，在即将统一大陆之前猝死，穿越到异世界，成了一只西幻魔物哥布林。
发现自己成为哥布林后，李秦武是拒绝的，尤其是他发现，成年哥布林们随意把幼崽的他抛弃在路边杂草里，和丢垃圾一样，他就更绝望了。
在这个未知的原始森林，别说他只是个哥布林幼崽，就算是成年人他都没把握能活。
在李秦武打算摆烂重开之际，害他猝死的骑马与砍杀变成系统一起来到了异世界，并且初始就给了他三个属性点。
李秦武垂死惊坐起，二话不说把三个属性点加在活力属性上。

骑马与砍杀2的活力属性可以增加他使用单手剑，双手剑，长杆武器的威力，也有字面意思，增加他的“活力”，这让他度过了最艰难的幼崽阶段。
之后的很长一段时间，李秦武都趴在杂草里生活，为了活下去，他疯狂吃草，愣是靠吃草活了下来。
同时他仔细观察，发现部落里的成年哥布林时不时能打到猎物，可始终没人给他这只楚楚可怜的哥布林幼崽吃一口。
另外，哥布林部落里没有雌性哥布林，李秦武好奇，没有雌性哥布林，他是哪里来的？
然后他就看到，捕猎归来的成年哥布林活捉了雌性动物，这给李秦武幼小的心灵产生了极大的震撼。
而更更更让他震撼的是，某天狩猎的哥布林队伍没有打到猎物，居然开始同类想食！没有反抗能力的哥布林幼崽是最先被吃掉的！
这让李秦武知道哥布林都是一群没有亲情的魔物，也坚定了他只能靠自己的想法！
现在已经是李秦武来到异世界的第14天了，这14天来，他靠吃路边的杂草活了下来，他发现哥布林的生长周期极短，仅14天他就快变成成年哥布林了，至少他有了站立行走的能力。
李秦武看着那副野猪骨架沉思，他低头在地上寻找着什么，不一会儿他捡起一块石头。
李秦武走到骨架旁，对准野猪牙就一顿敲，然后他得到了4颗野猪獠牙。
“用石头打磨一下，四根獠牙应该能做成四只匕首，如果有适合的树枝，应该还能做长茅！”
叽叽咕咕！
思索之际，他的肚子传来一声剧烈的轰鸣，紧接着就是刻骨铭心的饥饿感。
“卧槽！太他妈饿了！”
李秦武捂着自己的肚子，满脸痛苦，哥布林这玩意生长的速度快，可对食物的消耗也大，尤其他平时只能吃草，饥饿感来的就更快了。
“得赶紧去吃草，吃饱了去制作武器，然后去外面看看能不能打猎！”
尽管很饿，李秦武还是强迫自己转动脑筋，快速安排好行动计划就想去找草吃。
走之前他又扫了一眼野猪骨架，它被啃的干干净净，连一丝碎肉都没有，可当他的视线落在完整的猪腿骨上，眼前猛的就是一亮。
骨髓！这里面有骨髓啊！

Monster forest.
In a certain goblin tribe that looked like a garbage dump, hundreds of ugly-looking goblins who were only half the height of ordinary people gathered in a circle. They looked greedy and looked at a newly caught wild boar in the circle, swallowing their saliva.
Hunger made them want to pounce on it and bite it, but the tall figure eating next to the wild boar made them afraid to move in. That tall figure was the leader of this goblin tribe.
The leader Goblin is close to an ordinary person in height. For a Goblin who is less than one meter tall, he is already a giant. Not only is he tall, he is also extremely obese. His belly is round and full of fat. He is definitely a high-fat patient.
"Hiccup!"
The Goblin leader lay down next to the wild boar and began to bite it like crazy. When only half of the wild boar was left, he burped and staggered towards the thatched hut, the only building of the Goblin tribe.
He lay down directly, and a snoring sound immediately sounded. The sound was like a whistle in the cafeteria. Without the suppression of the leader, the goblins could no longer bear it and rushed forward to bite the half-drawn wild boar wildly.
After a while, half of the wild boar was gone, leaving only a skeleton in place. The goblins who had eaten and drank enough dispersed and found a place to lie down and sleep, with a good attitude of eating every meal.
After all the goblins fell asleep, the goblin cubs crawled out from various corners, greedily licking the pig blood mixed with the mud.
"No, I have to find another way out!"
A goblin cub looked at the miserable appearance of its brothers lying on the ground chewing sand, and thought so in his heart.
This goblin is called Li Qinwu, a native of Blue Star. He stayed up late playing horseback riding and slashing a week ago. He died suddenly before unifying the continent. He traveled to a different world and became a western fantasy monster goblin.
After discovering that he had become a goblin, Li Qinwu refused, especially when he found that the adult goblins abandoned him as a cub in the weeds on the roadside, just like throwing garbage, which made him even more desperate.
In this unknown primeval forest, let alone a goblin cub, he had no chance of surviving even as an adult.
When Li Qinwu was planning to restart the game, the horse riding and slashing system that caused his sudden death came to a different world together, and initially gave him three attribute points.
Li Qinwu sat up in shock and added three attribute points to the vitality attribute without saying a word.
Mount & Blade 2's vitality attribute can increase his power with one-handed swords, two-handed swords, pole weapons, and also literally increase his "vitality", which allows him to survive the most difficult cub stage.
For a long time after that, Li Qinwu lived in the weeds. In order to survive, he ate grass crazily and survived by eating grass.
At the same time, he observed carefully and found that the adult goblins in the tribe could catch prey from time to time, but no one ever gave his pitiful little goblin a bite.
In addition, there were no female goblins in the Goblin tribe. Li Qinwu was curious, where did he come from if there were no female goblins?
Then he saw that the adult goblins who had returned from hunting had captured female animals alive, which greatly shocked Li Qinwu's young mind.
What shocked him even more was that one day, the Goblin team that was hunting failed to catch any prey and actually started to eat the same kind! The helpless goblinThe pups are the first to be eaten!
This made Li Qinwu know that goblins are a group of monsters without family ties, and it also solidified the idea that he could only rely on himself!
It is now the 14th day that Li Qinwu came to the other world. During these 14 days, he has survived by eating weeds on the roadside. He discovered that the growth cycle of goblins is extremely short. In just 14 days, he is about to become an adult goblin. At least he has the ability to stand and walk.
Li Qinwu looked at the wild boar skeleton and pondered. He lowered his head and looked for something on the ground. After a while, he picked up a stone.
Li Qinwu walked to the skeleton, aimed at the wild boar tusks and knocked them, and then he got 4 wild boar tusks.
"If you polish it with a stone, the four fangs should be able to be made into four daggers. If there are suitable branches, you should be able to make thatch!"
Chi chi chi chi!
While he was thinking, there was a violent roar in his stomach, followed by an unforgettable feeling of hunger.
"Fuck! I'm so damn hungry!"
Li Qinwu clutched his stomach, his face full of pain. Goblins grow very fast, but they also consume a lot of food. Especially since he can only eat grass, his hunger will come faster.
"You have to eat grass quickly, make weapons when you are full, and then go outside to see if you can hunt!"
Although he was very hungry, Li Qinwu still forced himself to think, quickly arranged an action plan and wanted to find grass.
Before leaving, he glanced at the wild boar skeleton again. It had been chewed clean, without even a trace of meat. But when his eyes fell on the intact pig leg bone, his eyes suddenly lit up.
marrow! There is bone marrow in it!
